summary: This directory defines the core abstractions and message structures required for communicating with AI models. It establishes a consistent interface for text generation and streaming, ensuring that chat content and participant roles are structured uniformly across the application.
responsibilities: Define the structure of chat messages and their associated content types
Provide a standard interface for AI model interaction
Support streaming and non-streaming response generation
relationships: The AI client utilizes chat messages to structure interactions with the model.
Chat content defines the specific format and data types allowed within a chat message.
designDecisions: Use of interfaces to decouple implementation details from AI model interactions
Standardized definitions for message roles and content types to ensure cross-module compatibility
